title: 主站灵感参考详情、媒体说明与本地笔记
goal: 理解媒体参考的身份、出处和边界，明确播放与记录本机观察，并可靠恢复失败。
workflow: 区分参考媒体与源站真实互动，不将视频当作可运行原作
核查媒体时间与错误，而不是仅看海报
确认标签是说明还是入口，匿名收藏是否要求账户
明确播放并可暂停或回到首帧，文字稿始终保留
本机笔记明确保存范围，复制失败提供手工路径
failure_recovery: 媒体失败保留海报与完整文字稿；存储不可用只保留当前标签页并说明旧记录可能存在；编辑后下载失效；复制未确认不报成功。
motion_contract: 蓝本没有自动播放；明确点击才播放原创静音短片；支持暂停、定位、重置，减少动态时仍默认静态并保留全文。
source_relationship_note: An outbound work-detail association does not certify that every current inner page won an award or matches a historical version.
evidence_note: Only recorded observations are facts. DOM structure does not prove visual composition, hidden state, source code, backend behavior or licenses. The runnable blueprint is an original recipe, not a source-site clone.

reference_contract.implementation: Original silent Canvas/VP8 film, SVG poster, transcript, text and fictional reference library; no source footage
reference_contract.reference_vs_original: Media is an observation aid, not a running reproduction of the original external interaction
reference_contract.media: Explicit playback only, native controls and full transcript survive no-JavaScript/data failure; duration metadata verified, media errors and denied play recoverable
reference_contract.tags: Source timeline tag observed as static taxonomy; local related-topic filter is an authored enhancement
reference_contract.notebook: One versioned localStorage key per reference; explicit save, tab-only fallback, truthful removal failures and invalidated downloads after edits
reference_contract.clipboard: Own HTTP URL only, strips query/fragment; success only after confirmed resolution; manual fallback on denial, absence or timeout
source_boundaries: Anonymous collect opens login; no credentials or account save
No full source footage/frames, auth or original external interaction audit
reference_contract.editing: Regenerate static content after reference.json edits; copied JSON must match rendered digest; own authored media already included
